A '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], and served under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Destroy" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> after the ''Malevolence'' suffered a defeat at the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]], the Separatist forces captured [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and brought her aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in order to force the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ships to stop their attack. The senator eventually escaped, and this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] along with a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 11 (Malevolence)|fellow battle droid]] were sent to look for her.<ref name="Destroy" />

Meanwhile, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] devised a plan to board the Separatist [[Warship/Legends|warship]] by using their [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 ''Rigger''-class light freighter]], the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], to latch onto one of the exterior air locks. This [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] and the other one felt the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] board the ship, but dismissed the idea that someone could have docked at the emergency air locks. Shortly thereafter, the two Jedi exited the ship and confronted the droids, destroying them.<ref name="Destroy" />
